final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

`formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100 and showed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`. Those amounts are now printed as-is, giving `¥500`.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoices and the cart total also show yen correctly now. Nothing else in the repo handles JPY specially, and no other tests cover it. If any caller was already dividing yen by 100 before calling it, that caller would now be wrong, but I found none.
